module purpose: Synchronous boot ROM: on clk_i it indexes an embedded ROM (mem_rom_c) with bus_req_i.addr and captures the selected 32-bit word into rdata; when a read strobe (bus_req_i.stb and not bus_req_i.rw) is latched as rden the module drives bus_rsp_o.data with that word and asserts bus_rsp_o.ack (bus_rsp_o.err is tied low).

use-case flows.value: detection and latching of a bus read request (strobe AND read) into rden
read a 32-bit ROM word selected by the request address into the register rdata on clk_i
deliver the stored rdata word onto the bus (bus_rsp_o.data) when rden = '1'
report read completion and error status via bus_rsp_o.ack and bus_rsp_o.err
clear the read-enable latch (rden) when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Boot ROM read data — the 32-bit word taken from the embedded boot ROM and returned on the bus
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access process reads mem_rom_c at the address formed from bus_req_i.addr and stores that word into rdata on the rising edge of clk_i (line 48); bus_rsp_o.data is driven from rdata when rden = '1' (line 64). The relationship map records rdata as CLOCKED_BY clk_i at its occurrence for the mem_access assignment (rdata occurrence 2, CLOCKED_BY clk_i, line 48) and records bus_rsp_o.data as DERIVES_FROM rdata and GATED_BY rden at the bus response assignment (bus_rsp_o occurrence 2, DERIVES_FROM rdata / GATED_BY rden, line 64). These lines and records establish that the module's observable bus data is the ROM word captured in rdata, so the integrity of the ROM-read value as delivered on bus_rsp_o.data is established by the RTL.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-response decision — the latched signal that enables returning data and drives the ack (rden)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process latches rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) on the rising edge of clk_i (line 60) and clears rden on reset (lines 57-58). rden gates the output data (bus_rsp_o.data is driven only when rden = '1', line 64) and is copied to bus_rsp_o.ack (line 65). The map shows bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw have GATES records targeting rden (bus_req_i fields gate rden at line 60), rden is CLOCKED_BY clk_i at its occurrence for the latch (rden occurrence 3, CLOCKED_BY clk_i, line 60), and bus_rsp_o.ack COPIES rden at the ack assignment (bus_rsp_o occurrence 3, COPIES rden, line 65). Because rden both controls delivery and is reported as ack, the RTL establishes the integrity property of this decision: corrupting rden would cause incorrect ack/data behavior.

conceptual assets.concept: Requested address (the bus-provided address bits that select which ROM word is read)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access assignment indexes the ROM with bus_req_i.addr(boot_rom_size_index_c+1 downto 2) and uses that index to select the word written into rdata (line 48). The relationship map records that bus_req_i.addr SELECTS rdata at that mem access (bus_req_i.addr occurrence 2, SELECTS -> rdata, line 48). Because the returned word depends on the request address, the RTL establishes that the integrity of the requested address (as received on bus_req_i) matters to which ROM contents are delivered.
